posts.title: Seasonal house cleaning in Greer before the holidays
posts.text:
Is house cleaning in Greer SC worth booking before the holidays? In late November, most homes around Downtown Greer, Trade Street and the newer streets near GSP Airport get busy fast. Guests arrive, the oven works overtime, and the front hall collects leaves, mud and red clay from the first cold weeks.

Our team handles this season room by room. We start in the kitchen, where counters, the stovetop, the sink and appliance fronts take the hardest use in November. Then bathrooms, where guest towels and extra showers add up, and finally floors, which we vacuum and mop by hand so the corners and edges get the attention a machine skips. Baseboards and door frames get touched up on a rotation, which is where holiday dust tends to settle.

A recurring weekly or biweekly visit also keeps December from turning into one big cleanup. You decide the schedule after a free in-home estimate, when we see the space and give you an exact price with no commitment. Tap Learn more to see what a regular visit includes in Greer.

posts.title: How long house cleaning takes in Marietta, SC
posts.text:
How long does a house cleaning take in Marietta? It depends on the size of the home, how many bathrooms it has, and how recently it was cleaned. A tidy three-bedroom on a quiet road off US-25 is a very different job from a larger place with pets and a full set of windowsills.

That is why we do not quote from a phone call. During the free in-home estimate, a member of our team walks through the kitchen, bathrooms and floors, notes anything unusual, and tells you how many people and how many hours the visit needs. You get an exact price right then, with no commitment to book.

A regular visit covers kitchen counters, sink and stovetop, appliance fronts, bathrooms from toilet to chrome, dusting of surfaces and shelves, beds made, trash emptied, and floors vacuumed and mopped by hand. Baseboards and door frames are touched up on a rotation, so nothing is ignored for long. Marietta is about 16 miles from our Greer base, an easy drive up US-276. posts.title: Why Landrum homes get a Brazilian deep cleaning
posts.text:
Why do Landrum homeowners ask for a deep cleaning from a Brazilian team? Usually because they have noticed what a regular clean leaves behind: grease on cabinet fronts, grime in the grout lines, and dust packed into ceiling fan blades and vents. Landrum has plenty of older homes with detailed trim and wide baseboards, and that kind of woodwork collects dirt in places a quick wipe never reaches.

Our Brazilian detail-first method is simple. We work from the top of each room down, so dust falls onto surfaces we have not cleaned yet. Baseboards and door frames are wiped by hand, window sills and tracks are cleaned, and the area behind and around the toilet base is scrubbed, a spot many people forget. In the kitchen we degrease cabinet fronts and handles, then clean the range hood, backsplash and appliance exteriors.

Deep cleaning also works well before starting recurring service, so the regular visits begin from a clean baseline. We are based in Greer, about 16 miles from Landrum off I-26 and US-176. Tap Learn more to see what a deep cleaning includes in Landrum.
